title: Broken Access Control
description: Hidden origins exposed by fronted channels bypass coarse IP/DNS allow-lists.

title: Cryptographic Failures
description: Weak/legacy cipher advertising inside ClientHello must be recorded.

title: Injection
description: Host/:authority validation prevents request-route injection.

title: Insecure Design
description: Design must assume attacker controls SNI and Host independently.

title: Security Misconfiguration
description: CDN fronting relies on permissive TLS termination configs.

title: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
description: Edge TLS stacks and proxy engines must be patched.

title: Identification and Authentication Failures
description: Origin must not rely on SNI as a bearer of identity.

title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
description: Trust decisions must validate Host + authority consistently end-to-end.

title: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
description: SNI/Host telemetry must feed SIEM pipelines for detection.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery
description: Fronted channels can turn the CDN edge into an SSRF proxy toward origins.

title: Govern
description: Establish org-wide policy for allowed egress and obfuscation use.

title: Identify
description: Inventory of origins, CDN edges and expected SNI/Host pairings.

title: Protect
description: TLS 1.3 policies, pinned certificate discipline, allow-list defaults.

title: Detect
description: Continuous SNI/authority/TTL/JA4 analytics on egress & ingress.

title: Respond
description: Playbooks to terminate or quarantine fronted channels.

title: Recover
description: Restore clean routing tables after remediation.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
description: Assign ownership for egress and obfuscation-monitoring capability.

title: Acceptable use of information and assets
description: Define acceptable egress domains and prohibit unauthorised fronting.

title: Configuration management
description: Version-controlled edge / TLS / proxy configuration baselines.

title: Information deletion
description: Ensure telemetry retention satisfies data-handling policy.

title: Monitoring activities
description: Active monitoring of networks, systems and applications for misuse.

title: Networks security
description: Segment and filter egress so fronted channels cannot reach origins.

title: Use of cryptography
description: Cryptographic policy applied consistently to egress TLS.

title: Secure coding
description: Host/:authority validation in application code; no implicit trust of SNI.
